items.question: How many hours a day are car rental offices at UAE airports open?
items.gold: Car rental offices at UAE airports are open 24 hours.
items.fact: Airport car rental offices open 24 hours daily

items.question: Are wheelchairs offered free of charge for passengers at UAE airports?
items.gold: Yes, wheelchairs and strollers are offered free of charge.
items.fact: Airport wheelchairs and strollers are free of charge
